objective: Verify that the protected GitHub OIDC target identity can authorize the existing ServiceTracer demo API VM extension update without mutating Azure.
success_criteria: Protected target OIDC login succeeds in the expected subscription and tenant.
ARM validation succeeds for the existing extension-only template.
What-If contains exactly one material Modify for the existing servicetracer-demo-api extension.
Resource inventory remains seven resources before and after.
Public API health remains HTTP-successful and healthy.
No Azure mutation, workload deployment, transaction replay, merge, publication, or cleanup occurs.
failure_behavior: Fail closed, upload available sanitized evidence, and preserve effective permission as unverified.
cost_implication: No recurring Azure resource is created. GitHub Actions execution and Azure control-plane requests may incur only ordinary platform usage; no compute, disk, public IP, network, or quota-consuming resource change is authorized.
claim_boundary: This authorization permits verification only. A successful result does not authorize deployment and does not renew the previously consumed deployment grant.
